title: IoT Traffic Anomaly Detection
description: A streaming detector that flags abnormal device behaviour on the campus IoT network, running lightweight models on the edge gateway so alerts land in seconds rather than after a batch job.

title: Mobile Forensics Toolkit
description: An acquisition and timeline-reconstruction toolkit for Android devices, built around reproducible, evidence-grade extraction steps that hold up under review.

title: Campus Sensor Mesh
description: A low-power wireless mesh of environmental sensors across the department building, with an aggregation layer that feeds a live dashboard and a public API.

title: Distributed Log Pipeline
description: A fault-tolerant ingestion pipeline that collects, normalises, and indexes logs from every lab service, giving the security track one queryable timeline to hunt across.

title: Secure Session Handoff
description: A protocol and reference implementation for passing an authenticated session between a user's devices without re-authenticating, with formal checks on the key exchange.
